requirements.text: The system shall enable the resubmit link only for rejected applications.
The system shall disable the resubmit link for approved applications.
The system shall allow admin users to review and approve resubmitted applications.
The system shall provide a new link to assign badges that is enabled only for approved applications.
The system shall open a new page containing application details and badge options when the assign badges link is clicked by an admin.
The system shall update the application status to completed (statusId 200) after a badge is assigned.
The system shall display a new grid in the admin dashboard strictly listing completed applications.
The system shall allow admin users to view assigned badges within the completed applications grid.
